author: MichaelNguyen5653
comment:codemirror: Pinned to the EXACT versions obsidian's peerDependencies declare. These packages are `external` in esbuild — Obsidian supplies them at runtime — so the pins only feed TypeScript. Using a different version typechecks against an API that isn't what ships. Re-check with `npm view obsidian@latest peerDependencies` when bumping obsidian.
